caption:
Wholesale prices are up 6.5% from a year ago. 📈

The BLS says producer prices rose 0.3% in October, a little less than expected. But the yearly rate is the highest since late 2022.

Producer prices are what businesses pay, and that can show up on shelves later.

Have you noticed prices creeping up in your cart lately?
